answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can hold each agent's earnings in escrow that releases slowly, like nectar drawn gradually from a hive, while random audits act as a beacon that exposes clusters of fake identities sharing the same behavior. A public atlas of reputation then maps which identities have survived repeated audits, so creating thousands of throwaway agents costs time and locked income without ever reaching full payout, while honest agents keep building a verifiable history.
